description: Governed Trinity API book of trusted public and operational surfaces with bounded usage patterns.

apis.purpose: Ground theory and publication signals with bounded public metadata lookups.
apis.fallback_behavior: Fall back to the public source registry and cached public research artifacts when live calls are skipped.
apis.notes: Use to ground current theory and publication signals without converting them into readiness claims.

apis.purpose: Pull bounded recency and citation-context signals from a public academic index.
apis.fallback_behavior: Use cached public research artifacts and explicit open-gap notes if live refresh is skipped.
apis.notes: Use for recency and citation-context signals only.

apis.purpose: Pull bounded preprint signals without promoting them to readiness claims.
apis.fallback_behavior: Use cached research notes and keep preprint-derived claims in inference or open-gap only.
apis.notes: Use as a public preprint signal with explicit evidence boundaries.

apis.purpose: Pull bounded theory-context graph signals from a public research API.
apis.fallback_behavior: Fall back to Crossref/OpenAlex cached traces when live graph queries are skipped.
apis.notes: Use as a bounded theory-context signal source.

apis.purpose: Check branch-scoped remote mirror reachability and collaboration posture.
apis.quick_call: git fetch origin && git push origin HEAD:<branch>
apis.fallback_behavior: Keep the repo authoritative and continue local work if the remote is unavailable.
apis.notes: Never write directly to main; branch-scoped only.

apis.purpose: Mirror actionable work into Linear without changing repo authority.
apis.fallback_behavior: Keep the work in repo-first artifacts if Linear is unavailable in the current session.
apis.notes: Use for actionable work mirrors only.

apis.purpose: Mirror summaries and dashboards into Notion without changing repo authority.
apis.fallback_behavior: Keep summaries in repo-first markdown and JSON artifacts if Notion is unavailable.
apis.notes: Repo remains authoritative; Notion is a bounded mirror.

apis.purpose: Check runtime/query posture for the local synthetic mesh and summary store.
apis.fallback_behavior: Treat Postgres as blocked and continue repo-first if the local runtime is unavailable.
apis.notes: Use for runtime/query state and synthetic mesh, not authority.

apis.purpose: Record the deferred archive target without attempting activation in v12.
apis.fallback_behavior: Keep all archive posture local and repo-first until the operator lifts the hold.

apis.purpose: Check bounded local runtime truth and container health.
apis.fallback_behavior: Mark Docker as blocked and continue repo-first if the CLI or daemon is unavailable.
apis.notes: Use for local runtime truth and bounded simulations.

apis.purpose: Summarize current memory-bank authority and mirror posture in one low-pressure command.
apis.fallback_behavior: Read the registry directly if the helper script is unavailable.
apis.notes: Use when the laptop is under pressure and we need one concise storage posture view.

apis.purpose: Summarize the current public research validation and signal-board posture.
apis.fallback_behavior: Fall back to the latest public research validation and signal-board artifacts directly.
apis.notes: Use to check public-source research posture without forcing a live refresh.

apis.purpose: Anchor DID governance comparisons against the current public standard.
apis.fallback_behavior: Use the cached public source registry and governance briefs if live browsing is skipped.
apis.notes: Primary governance anchor for DID claims.

apis.purpose: Anchor verifiable credential comparisons against the current public standard.
apis.fallback_behavior: Use the cached public source registry and governance briefs if live browsing is skipped.
apis.notes: Primary governance anchor for verifiable credentials claims.
